data_version.title: Material-repair release
data_version.body: Nine scenes and 1,336 stereo views from the frozen 2026-09-23 material-repair release. The release removes 56 confirmed duplicates from the earlier 1,392-frame set. RGB, depth, normals, instance IDs and masks shown here all come from the same release.

modalities.label: RGB
modalities.note: Stereo RGB from the frozen material-repair release

modalities.label: Depth
modalities.note: Isaac-native axial ground-truth depth; shown as an offline color map

modalities.label: Instances
modalities.note: Isaac-native compact instance IDs; each ID keeps one color within the view

modalities.label: Normals
modalities.note: Isaac-native world-frame XYZ normals mapped to RGB

modalities.label: Unverified
modalities.note: Vessel regions whose material classification is unverified

hero.review_note: The hero pairs a room view with a vessel close-up. The 500 mL volumetric flask in lab060/0058 has a clean silhouette on the black bench, with the multilevel shelves behind it. The inset uses the conical flask in frame 0092.

curation.method: pipeline/score.py computes exposure, contrast, sharpness, vessel share, composition and structure for all 1,336 views; pipeline/pick.py ranks candidates with recorded weights, and reviewed changes with reasons are kept in pipeline/curation.json.

cover.review_note: The multilevel shelves define this scene; the algorithm's first choice, 0058, has a large black bench block in the lower left. Frame 0024 keeps the flasks and beakers legible on both shelves.
cover.rank_reason: Highest weighted score for exposure, sharpness, vessel share, composition and spatial coverage, with at least two visible vessels

closeup.review_note: Frame 0092 is a true close-up: one flask on the black bench with a readable rim and base.
